Downloads ZIP archive ('cveswindows.zip' for Windows, 'cveslinux.zip' for Linux) from external URL
Extracts and executes malware binaries ('cves_windows.exe' and 'cves_linux')
Windows version detected as password-stealing trojan
Malware downloader script embedded in fake proof-of-concept exploit repositories
Attack Vector: Fake GitHub repositories promoted on Twitter impersonating cybersecurity researchers
Downloading and executing malicious Python scripts from GitHub repositories
